# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Ganesh cache correction**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 clears stale Ganesh cache entries after failed GPU flushes. This bundled Skia update keeps cached GPU resources consistent when a flush does not complete successfully.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Stale Ganesh cache entries cleared** — Updates the bundled renderer to clear stale Ganesh cache entries after a failed GPU flush. ([#5253](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5253))
